description: Contemplating Mode (Parallel Multi-Agent Reasoning): New jev/contemplate.py using swarm.py for 3-agent fan-out with different reasoning seeds, merged by a judge agent. Add mode param to /v1/chat/completions (instant/thinking/contemplating). Add mode selector button group in Studio chat UI. Depends on FEAT-002 (events.py) for event emission.
steps: Edit jev/agent.py: add system_override kwarg to run_agent(task, files={}, budget_tokens=2048, session_id='', system_override=None). When system_override is provided, replace the SYSTEM constant with system_override in the messages list construction.

Edit jev/server.py /v1/chat/completions handler: extract mode = body.get('mode', 'instant'). Before calling route(), add: if mode == 'thinking': use reason.reason(msgs, max_tokens, temperature) and return structured response with thinking field. If mode == 'contemplating': call contemplate.contemplate(msgs, max_tokens, session_id=body.get('session_id','')), return response with answer + branches. Add 'reasoning_mode' field to all response objects. Import contemplate lazily.

Edit jev/static/app.html: add mode selector below the chat input (above send button). Three buttons in a pill group: '⚡ Instant' (default), '🤔 Think', '🧠 Contemplate'. Active mode stored in S.mode (default 'instant'). Button click updates S.mode and visual active state. Include mode in chat POST body: mode: S.mode. For contemplating mode, show a spinner with message 'Consulting 3 reasoning agents…'. After response, if branches array present, render collapsible <details> sections for each branch before the merged answer.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "from jev.contemplate import contemplate; print('import ok')"
POST /v1/chat/completions with mode:'instant' returns normal response
POST /v1/chat/completions with mode:'contemplating' returns {answer, branches:[3 items]}
Studio mode selector renders 3 buttons; active button highlighted
Contemplating response shows 3 collapsible branch details in Studio
